title: Terms of Service
intro: This is a stand-in. PartnerStandard Desk's hosted service at https://desk.partnerstandard.com shows its operator's own terms of service, which its build adds from a private place. A server you run yourself shows none of these pages: it links to your own, set with `LEGAL_TERMS_URL` (deploy/.env.example).

sections.heading: 1. What this page is
blocks: The text of the terms of service, as data: a title, the date they take effect, and numbered sections.
